text:
Oakbrook Investments LLC trimmed its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 4.9% in the third quarter, according to its most recent 13F filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The fund owned 281,626 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 14,514 shares during the quarter. Apple accounts for about 3.5% of Oakbrook Investments LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its biggest holding. Oakbrook Investments LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $63,574,000 SEC filing.
